project.name: osgi/boot
project.description: The embedded-OSGi boot family. Splits the boot concern into the MODEL — what to boot and how to find it — and its consumers. boot-discovery declares the model (the embed capability, the BootStackJar registry, the classpath bundle index); the host-world executor osgi/runtime and the test-world OutOfContainerFrameworkExtension both consume it, so prod and test agree on the boot topology by sharing one model rather than re-implementing it.
